profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Skilled full-stack principal software engineer and architect experienced with organizing and executing complex projects under numerous development methodologies. My wide background in a number of technologies helps me to develop creative solutions to complex problems.

Specialties:
● Application Architecture 
● Software Development
● Web Application Development
● Systems Integration
● Test Automation/Unit Testing
● Performance Profiling & Optimization
● Database Design & Administration
● Linux/UNIX Administration
● Security Analysis/Penetration Testing
● Full-Stack Application Technologies

Languages: 
 Ruby, Javascript, Python, Go, Java, Perl, C, C++, BASH/Shell

Frameworks: 
Ruby on Rails, Sinatra, Node.js, Backbone, React, jQuery, Rspec, Webdriver, Watir, Selenium, Cucumber, Capybara

Design Patterns:
MVC, MVVM, MVP, Client-Server, Multi-Threaded, RESTful API 

Object Mappers (ORM/ODM):
ActiveRecord, Mongoid, Bookshelf

Databases: 
Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MongoDB

Systems (OS): 
MAC OS X, Linux, UNIX, BSD, Windows, VMWare ESX, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS

Software/Tools:
 GIT/SVN/CVS, GitHub/GitLab, RVM, Hudson/Jenkins/Bamboo, Crucible,
 Jira/Pivotal Tracker, Bugzilla, Apache/Nginx, Passenger/Thin,
 Puma/Unicorn, Chef/Puppet, SaltStack, Grunt, GPG, Make, RPM,
 MOCK, many more...

Networking: 
 Sonet/SDH, ATM, IPv4 and IPv6, Ethernet, VoIP, TCP/IP, IDS/IPS,
 Routing/Switching, EGP/IGP, SSL, SSH, Telnet, FTP, DNS, SMTP,
 HTTP, IMAP, POP3, System Architect

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and develop full stack software solutions for Perchwell's premier data and workflow technology platform for residential and commercial real estate.

⇨ Technologies Used
Javascript, Ruby, Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Docker, AWS

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I designed and developed third party integrations with upstream partners while providing a RESTful microservice for client consumption within the overall SOA. Played an integral part in major aspects of all services within the architecture as well as many internal management tools. Lead efforts to adopt more modern and idiomatic design approaches.

⇨ Technologies Used
Ruby 2, 3+, Rails 6, 7, 8+, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Docker, AWS

positions.title: Owner/Architect
positions.description:
Designed and developed a distributed video content distribution platform based on the IPFS protocol. Responsible for all front and back end design and development as well as devops/infrastructure to host the service.

⇨ Technologies Used
React 16 (ES6+) fronted with Ruby/Rails 5 RESTFul API backend. IPFS, Redis, Resque, MySQL, nGinx, websockets, Elasticsearch, Node micro services, Cloudflare, Kibana, Bugsnag and Capistrano are some of the more notable technologies utilized.

positions.title: Platform Technical Lead
positions.description:
Lead development efforts on Cloudsnap's Platform product.

⇨ Technologies Used
Ruby/Rails, Sidekiq, Redis, Websockets, Pubsub, CodeDeploy, MVC, RDS, EC2, Elasticsearch

positions.title: Principal Software Lead
positions.description:
Responsible for leading all backend development efforts on the Dealerware and Audi Select products. 

⇨ Technologies Used
Node/Hapi, Ruby/Rails, Docker, Resque, React, Angular, AWS, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SOA

positions.title: Owner / Architect
positions.description:
Designed and developed a fully automated suite of software to day trade the foreign currency exchange 24 hours a day 5 days a week. The software currently trades across 70 currency pairs with plans to extend to commodities.

⇨ Technologies Used
Ruby, React.js, MongoDB, Mongoid, Sinatra, Linux, Shell Scripting

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description:
Managed, designed and developed custom application software for customer engagements and internal company products. Area of focus was on cloud deployment and management suites utilizing RESTful technologies integrating numerous external systems.

⇨ Technologies Used
Ruby, Java, Javascript, Go, Sinatra, Backbone, Bootstrap, jQuery, Grunt, RequireJS, Puppet, Ansible, Node.js, React.js, MongoDB, MySQL, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, vRA/vRO

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, managed and developed Dell DCS software suite used to manage rack configuration data down to server component level with the purpose of automatic validation prior to delivery. Validation results are logged and analyzed for trends to improve process and quality of product.

⇨ Technologies Used
Ruby on Rails, Unobtrusive Javascript (Ajax on Rails), MySQL, Saltstack, and Chef

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to the development effort of the Metasploit RoR application as well as cucumber/selenium test automation suite.

⇨ Technologies Used
Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Rspec, Selenium, Cucumber
